answer: The wander graph is validated at intake and the trellis frontier is published, which means the ancestry of every answer is public, and ferrous anchors the chain at a checkpoint. Every submission must name 4 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1693 impostors cost 1701 times the honest price and take 22 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
